## Change summary

Describe behavior, contracts, data, security, and operational impact.

## Validation

- [ ] Repository formatting, linting, type checking, tests, and build pass.
- [ ] Tests cover authorization, tenant isolation, idempotency, and failure recovery where applicable.
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive customer data appear in code, logs, examples, or fixtures.
- [ ] Shared contract changes are versioned in `parc-contracts`.
- [ ] Schema changes include migration, validation, and forward-fix analysis.
- [ ] No cross-service database access or source imports were introduced.

## Review and rollout

List dependencies, deployment order, feature flags, monitoring, rollback/forward-fix plan, and required approvals.
